purpose: Promote character-list text to the native Web Prolog default and deploy it consistently with SWI-WASM and Trealla.

language_contract.unicode: one atom per Unicode scalar character
language_contract.native_libraries: Host implementation modules and explicit SWI library string interfaces retain native strings; language boundaries convert text explicitly.
language_contract.startup: No opt-in is required. The former WP_EXPERIMENTAL_TEXT=portable-text-0.2 setting remains accepted for existing launchers.

pinned_native_demonstrator_ci.demonstrator_T4_rerun: passed after updating three obsolete native-string assertions; original full-run results retained

regression_gates.swi_trealla_full_interop: passed on final exact native revision
regression_gates.model_examples: Public model actor/statechart tests now require the exact character-list reply instead of searching for a native-string display substring. Three retained demonstrator node tests now assert exact character-list goal/source, RPC and toplevel values while retaining sharing, Unicode and error assertions.

initial_diagnostics.detail: An initial native T3 run missed a secondary supervisor down notification in a zero-timeout poll. Focused and subsequent full-tier runs passed. The final complete CI run passed T3.

An intermediate full-T3 rerun exited with a SWI segmentation fault during the statechart spawn/kill determinism fixture. A subsequent full-T3 rerun and the final complete CI run passed; the original log is retained. No engine change or claim of repairing that engine-level transient is made.

The initial MODEL and MODEL_SXML public-output checks expected contiguous native-string display. They were replaced with exact character-list reply assertions and both pass in the final complete CI run. The remaining three native-string-only node assertions were replaced with exact portable character-list expectations; the full demonstrator T4 tier then passed.

deployment.text_setting: native package default; no experimental environment flag
